citation: Ali, Orfi, and Najib (2020), Developing and validating a dynamic model of water production by direct-contact membrane distillation
study_type: Dynamic model compared with pilot transient experiments
system_scope: 10 m² spiral-wound counter-current DCMD; stepped hot-feed conditions; 50–300 L/h
empirical_data_or_code: Five publisher-listed XLSX supporting-data files; extraction pending
source_supported_finding: Measured accumulated mass is sampled every 10 s; cold inlet temperature fluctuates and heater steps are not instantaneous. The paper reports substantial uncorrected mismatch and about 3% error only after a tuned heat-loss correction.
relevance_to_this_project: Candidate transient validation source for testing workload/heat intermittency and model response lag.
limitation_or_non_claim: The published tuned result is not independent validation; exact input histories and raw/processed-data distinctions must be reconstructed before model comparison.
license_or_reuse_note: CC BY 4.0 per publisher; attribute source and document modifications.

empirical_data_or_code: Open-access early version with supplementary material; quantitative extraction pending

license_or_reuse_note: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; do not redistribute adapted tables/figures; extract facts with attribution and verify reuse conditions.

citation: Villa et al. (2018), Membrane Specifications for Multi-Configuration Membrane Distillation Model
study_type: Public data repository / experimental specification files
system_scope: Multiple DCMD and AGMD configurations, including flat-sheet and spiral-wound modules
empirical_data_or_code: GDR workbook retrieved with SHA-256 manifest; 12 temperature-condition sheets exported and condition-level flux summary committed
source_supported_finding: Twelve nominal temperature conditions have cumulative distillate-volume and temperature time series; OLS-derived fluxes span approximately 2.14–10.53 L m⁻² h⁻¹. The workbook summary flux exactly matches the OLS transform, so it is a non-independent processing cross-check.
relevance_to_this_project: Open, reusable candidate for temperature-response validation and geometry-aware DCMD model checks; source checksum and extraction transformations are recorded.
limitation_or_non_claim: Workbook has a conflicting CLARCOR label on the Theoretical sheet, a constant 42.0 Flux (LMH) column, near-zero signed MD Water Flux values, and negative/Inf flow channels. Use cumulative volume/time and measured temperatures; resolve flow provenance before fitting. Model validation is still pending.
license_or_reuse_note: GDR submission links CC BY 4.0; attribute the dataset, link the license, identify changes, and keep raw time-series measurements separate from derived Theoretical-sheet calculations.

citation: Chen et al. (2026), 实验研究：基于CPU余热的膜蒸馏海水淡化系统 (Experimental study of a membrane-distillation desalination system based on CPU waste heat)
doi_or_identifier: Journal of Zhejiang Sci-Tech University (Natural Sciences), 2026(01); CNKI record: ZJSG202601009
study_type: Experimental system study (bibliographic record and abstract only verified)
system_scope: CPU waste heat coupled to membrane-distillation seawater desalination; operating parameters include CPU power, feed temperature, permeate flow, and salinity
empirical_data_or_code: CNKI metadata/abstract record; full article and underlying dataset not retrieved
source_supported_finding: Abstract reports stable operation above 240 W waste heat; at 360 W CPU heat and 55 °C feed temperature it reports 12.4 kg m⁻² h⁻¹ flux, 35.2% thermal efficiency, 46.8% heat-dissipation efficiency, and 0.09 kWh equivalent electricity savings; trends depend on flow, temperature, and salinity.
relevance_to_this_project: Directly overlaps the broad concept of CPU waste heat driving membrane distillation, so the project's novelty must not be framed as the first waste-heat-to-MD concept. It motivates a stricter systems-level contribution: time-resolved AI workload coupling, full cooling/pumping and electricity-water burdens, counterfactual freshwater displacement, geographic context, and independently auditable net-water break-even conditions.
limitation_or_non_claim: Only abstract-level evidence verified; methods, system boundary, cooling-water accounting, uncertainty, and raw data are unavailable here. Reported metrics cannot be independently checked or compared directly with the current model. The CPU experimental setup is not automatically representative of a data-center cooling loop.
license_or_reuse_note: CNKI page indicates journal download/access restrictions; cite bibliographic facts and abstract with attribution. Do not reproduce article figures/tables or claim the dataset is open.
